text:
The evidence should be excluded because FRE 404(b) prohibits admitting prior bad acts to show propensity—i.e., that the man was more likely to have molested this child because he did so in similar past cases. The prosecution has asserted only this improper propensity purpose, not any permissible non-propensity purpose such as motive, intent, identity, or plan.

CONFIDENCE: 95
